# `McpDoctor`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Doctor\McpDoctor`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/Doctor/McpDoctor.php)

Health/readiness diagnostics for the MCP server configuration: runs a fixed
set of checks in diagnosis order (root causes first) and returns an
immutable DoctorReport. Backs the `mcp:doctor` console command.

Checks: endpoint secret configured (config), session directory usable and
a session round-trip through the configured store (storage), OpenAPI spec
loadable (config for a local file, upstream for a URL), server build
(config). Network is touched only when explicitly requested
(diagnose() with `$probeUpstream = true`) — with a URL spec the
spec fetch AND the server build (which loads the spec eagerly) are skipped
otherwise, so the base health check stays local.

Details never contain the configured secret or header VALUES, and any URL
printed is stripped of userinfo credentials. Exception messages from
application services are passed through (truncated) — a blanket "no
secrets ever" promise is not enforceable over arbitrary third-party
exceptions, so treat doctor output as operator-facing diagnostics, not
something to hand to untrusted parties.

## Methods

### diagnose()

```php
diagnose(bool $probeUpstream): Doctor\DoctorReport
```
